measure_description: Re-measured 2026-08-15 with utils/measure using 10 identical Base Coin modules from Paulmann article 92466 connected in parallel (MULTIPLE_LIGHTS=true, NUM_LIGHTS=10) on a Shelly 1PM Gen3, because a single module draws below the meter's resolution floor of ~0.8 W. Reported values are per module. color_temp was measured with SAMPLE_COUNT=3 and hs with SAMPLE_COUNT=2; measure_settings below reflects the hs run.
name: Base Coin 50mm 420lm 4.9W RGBW+
